Many sessions (dozens of tasks to collect around 435 crystal splinters)

The gnomes suspect there is an entrance to an unknown place in the crypt beneath Kazordoon. You help the crypt guard, {npc:Brodraem Orcbeard}, to clear it, discover the rift that leads to the new areas and, with a gnome crystal shield that you keep upgrading through tasks, explore Antrum of the Fallen, Grotto of the Lost and Dwelling of the Forgotten until you defeat {creature:The Brainstealer}. You earn two {item:Eldritch Casket|Eldritch Caskets}, permission to buy more and the achievement **Some Like It Hot**.
Strange activity has been reported in a crypt beneath Kazordoon. Can you stand the heat and help the gnomes' investigation?
Having done the **Recruitment** mission of the {wiki:Bigfoot's Burden Quest}.
Recommended team for the hardest tasks and for the bosses {creature:The Mega Magmaoid} and {creature:The Brainstealer}.
useful in the Fishing in Lava Pools task
from Brodraem, after you clear the crypt
one when you reach shield level 3 and another after the Brainstealer
Permission to buy more Eldritch Caskets from {npc:Gnomevisor} for 75 crystal splinters
After clearing the Kazordoon crypt (*Cursed Crypt*), {npc:Gnomevisor} gives you the level 1 crystal shield ({key:hi}, {key:expecting}, {key:splinters}, {key:missions}, {key:layer}).
Level 2 crystal shield: with 20 crystal splinters say {key:shield} to {npc:Gnomevisor}.
Level 3 crystal shield (40 splinters); the deeper floors require levels 4, 5 and 6.
After defeating {creature:The Brainstealer} and reporting to {npc:Gnomevisor}.
After defeating {creature:The Brainstealer} and reporting to {npc:Gnomevisor}.

The quest loop is always the same: **kill creatures** to gather *protective layers* → spend 20 layers to **enter a task** → the task gives **crystal splinters** → spend the splinters to **upgrade the shield** with {npc:Gnomevisor} ({key:shield}) → you access new zones.
Check your progress (layers and splinters) in the quest log.
Keep an eye on the two numbers next to your character's name: the **shield** (blue icon) drops 1 point every 5 seconds; the **heat** (fire icon) rises over time.

If the heat reaches 50 you start losing 7.5% of your current health as Death Damage every few seconds (*"Madness is hurting you!"*). Stand on one of the machines in the zones for a few seconds: they lower the heat in steps of 5 points.
If you want more {item:Replacement Marble|Replacement Marbles} for decoration, pick them up from the coffin **before** you advance in the quest (once an hour).

Go to **Kazordoon**. The simplest way is the {wiki:Steamship}: from the port of Edron, {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you to Cormaya ({key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes}); in Cormaya go down 8 floors to {npc:Gurbasch} and say {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}. You arrive at the underground port of Kazordoon, next to {npc:Brodrosch}. There is also a steamship from Farmine.

Go down to the Kazordoon crypt and talk to {npc:Gnomystery}. Say {key:hi}, {key:talk}, {key:favour} and {key:yes}. The gnomes suspect an entrance to an unknown place in the crypt to the north, but the guard will not let them in. The crypt is beneath Kazordoon, on floor 9 (2 floors below ground level).
Talk to {npc:Brodraem Orcbeard}, right next to you. Say {key:hi}, {key:incidents} and {key:yes} to accept investigating the crypt.
Take the tools from the coffin
Use the **easternmost** square of the closed wooden coffin (see image). You get a {item:Chisel}, a {item:Brush} and 5 {item:Replacement Marble|Replacement Marbles}.
The wooden coffin: use the easternmost square

The coffin is restocked once an hour (*"The coffin is restocked once an hour. Come back later."*). After you finish this part, it stops giving items (*"You don't need this stuff in the coffin anymore."*).
Walk **north** to the fence, where the dirty sarcophagi, the broken floor and the ruined columns are. Use the tools:
Go back to {npc:Brodraem Orcbeard} and say {key:hi}. He thanks you and gives you a {item:White Gem}.
Enter the crypt again, walk **north** and head towards the big fissure until you fall to the floor below.

Down there, walk **east** and step into the teleport. You arrive in a room with 6 {creature:Diremaw|Diremaws}. Walk around the room until *"This place triggers memories! You have seen these creatures already somewhere else."* appears and the quest log is updated.
To go back to {npc:Gnomystery}, return through the teleport and climb up again to the Kazordoon crypt (floor 9). The wiki does not describe this way back in detail.
Go back to {npc:Gnomystery} and say {key:hi}, {key:talk} and {key:news}. The gnomes will send people to explore the crypt and you can help them down there.
The shield is not an item: it is a protection given by the gnomes. Each level (1 to 6) gives access to a deeper part of the crypt.

Go back to the crypt, pass the teleport and you reach a hub where {npc:Gnomevisor} is. Say {key:hi}, {key:expecting}, {key:splinters}, {key:missions} and {key:layer}. You receive the crystal shield level 1 (capacity 360). The hub is on floor 10, beneath the crypt.
Blue shield icon next to the character's name

1) Kill creatures in the zones to earn **protective layers**. 2) With **20 layers** you can enter a task. 3) Each task gives **crystal splinters** (points, not items). 4) Spend the splinters to upgrade the shield with {npc:Gnomevisor} ({key:shield}). The shield drops 1 point every 5 seconds inside the crypts and, if it reaches zero, you have to leave. It renews automatically **once a day** when you enter the main hall.
The splinters and layers progress appears in the quest log
Full protection against heat (after the Brainstealer)

Each zone has its own teleport in the hub: {wiki:Antrum of the Fallen} (beneath Femor Hills) and, later, {wiki:Grotto of the Lost} and {wiki:Dwelling of the Forgotten} (far beneath the Ice Islands). To leave a zone, go back to the teleport you came in by and return to the hub of {npc:Gnomevisor}. Leave before the shield reaches zero: without a shield you can no longer stay inside the crypts.
The first two zones have two tasks each and are unlocked at the same time; in the third zone each task requires a different shield level.
3. Shield level 1: Antrum of the Fallen

With shield level 1, enter {wiki:Antrum of the Fallen} via the teleport **north-west** of the hub. Here there are {creature:Afflicted Strider|Afflicted Striders}, {creature:Blemished Spawn|Blemished Spawns} and {creature:Eyeless Devourer|Eyeless Devourers}.
Kill the creatures in the zone until you have 20 layers. Then you can enter one of the two tasks.

The entrance is on the **first floor** of the crypt, in a small room to the **east** (NPC {npc:Gnomoney}, say {key:mission}). As soon as you enter, take a {item:Gnome Shovel} from the chest and start digging. Each hole gives: nothing, stones, a {creature:Tunnel Devourer} or the treasure. You have **3 minutes**. When someone finds the treasure, everyone in the room receives 10 splinters.

If nothing comes out you can dig another hole straight away; if stones come out you are tired for a few seconds (*"This was quite exhausting. You need a little break."*). If you wake {creature:Tunnel Devourer|Tunnel Devourers}, kill them or run around the room: time is short.

The entrance is on the **second floor** of the crypt, in a room to the **north-east** (NPC {npc:Gnomonster}, say {key:mission}). You are teleported to a room with compartments: kill all the {creature:Toxic Swarm|Toxic Swarms} in **2 minutes**. At the start only five compartments have creatures (two in each); as you kill them 8 more appear in the central room — 18 in total.
The **last two** swarms in the central room have to die in the **same attack turn**, otherwise they resurrect.
4. Shield level 2: Grotto of the Lost

With 20 splinters, talk to {npc:Gnomevisor} and say {key:shield}. Shield level 2 (capacity 540) opens the {wiki:Grotto of the Lost}, with Fire creatures: {creature:Lavafungus}, {creature:Lavaworm} and {creature:Streaked Devourer}.
Talk to {npc:Gnomevisor} and say {key:shield}. If you do not have enough splinters he tells you how many are missing.
Both tasks are in the same small room: after the teleport, go down the stairs (or levitate) and head **north-west** to the marked ramp. The task teleports are above.

Enter the **north** teleport. Escort the {creature:Gnomish Explorer} through the cave and protect him from the {creature:Hungry Menace|Hungry Menaces} and the lava holes. On the other side of the cave let him investigate (counter next to his name); when it reaches 10, take him back to the entrance. You have **10 minutes**.
A Knight in front using {spell:Challenge} on the Hungry Menaces helps a lot. Heal the explorer with {spell:Mass Healing} and {item:Ultimate Healing Rune|Ultimate Healing Runes}.

Enter the **south** teleport. Pick up the {item:Gnome Pick} from the floor near the entrance and alternate between: (1) taking {item:Firewood} from the pile at the entrance and using it on the fireplace (there is a small cooldown); (2) using the pick to collect {item:Pieces of Eldritch Wax|wax} in the large area to the **south** and using the wax on the fireplace. Orange messages in the centre of the room show the progress. You have **3 minutes**.
The wax disappears quickly from the floor and from your inventory: do not dawdle.

It can be done by two: one goes to fetch wax further south, the other takes care of the firewood and the wax near the fireplace (the wax one sometimes helps with the firewood because of the cooldown).
5. Shield level 3: Dwelling of the Forgotten

With 40 splinters, upgrade the shield to level 3 (capacity 720) and you receive an {item:Eldritch Casket}. You gain access to the {wiki:Dwelling of the Forgotten}, a crypt with several floors, with {creature:Cave Chimera|Cave Chimeras}, {creature:Varnished Diremaw|Varnished Diremaws} and {creature:Tremendous Tyrant|Tremendous Tyrants}.

Enter through the **red** teleport in the **east**, on the second floor of the crypt. Pick up a {item:Gnomish Lava Fishing Rod} near the entrance. Kill {creature:Instable Fire|Instable Fires} so they drop {item:Sticky Elemental Goo} on the floor (you need it to fish). Stand next to the fire on top of the lava and use the rod on it. You need **15 data crystals** in **10 minutes**.
If your heat reaches **200** you are kicked out of the task.
Several mechanics make fishing difficult. Organise the team to lower the heat together:
Kill them quickly to pick up the Sticky Elemental Goo
When fishing, a {creature:Magma Fiend} can come out instead of a crystal
Does not count towards progress; kill it (it turns into a stone pillar, useful against the eruptions)
Heat rises over time (kicked out at 200)

Use the {item:Gnomish Supercooler} near the entrance: it fires a cold beam **east** and removes 60 heat. It only works every 40 seconds for the whole room (light on = ready), so put the whole team in front of the machine
The {creature:Glowing Lava|Glowing Lavas} cast Fire Berserk (+50 heat)
They cannot be killed, but they are easy to run away from
Every 25 s there is an orange warning in the centre of the room; 10 s later there are lava eruptions coming from the **north** or **west** (+50 heat)
Shield yourself behind a {item:Magic Wall Rune|Magic Wall} (away from the Glowing Lavas, which destroy magic walls) or behind the pillar of a dead {creature:Magma Fiend}
Successful fishing of a data crystal
Failed attempt that summons a Magma Fiend
Using the machine (Gnomish Supercooler) to lower the heat
Using a Magic Wall to avoid the lava eruption
With shield level 4 (capacity 1080) you have access to the third floor of the Dwelling of the Forgotten.
Enter through the **orange** teleport in the **east**, on the second floor of the crypt. The goal is to make your way to the **north** of the room in **10 minutes**.

A few seconds after you enter, five {item:Fiery Gnomish Stonesmasher|Fiery Gnomish Stonesmashers} appear near the entrance. Pick one up and use it on the {item:Sulphur Stone|Sulphur Stones} to clear a path. Keep the whole team on the same path to advance faster.

After 20 seconds the stonesmasher cools down and stops breaking stones. To reignite it: attack a {creature:Lavaling} until it drops below half health (it becomes a {creature:Fireling}) and use the stonesmasher on it; or let an explosion catch you. Then you get another 20 seconds of use.

If you take more than 60 seconds to reignite it, the stonesmasher disappears. If an explosion sets you on fire, put it out at the {item:Gnomish Fire Douser} (where you started); if the heat reaches 800 you are kicked out.

Further on, {wiki:Basaltwall|Basaltwalls} appear. The **first** is broken with a {creature:Fireling} next to it (it explodes after a few seconds). The **second and third** only with {creature:Instable Lavaling|Instable Lavalings}: lure a {creature:Lavaling} to a {item:Lava Hole (Dwelling)|Lava Hole} to transform it and then take it to the wall to explode.

A {creature:Fireling} that passes through a Lava Hole becomes {creature:Deadly Heat}: immortal, it follows you and gets in the way. To get rid of it, go south and put it out at the {item:Gnomish Fire Douser}.
Lure the Lavalings without transforming them and only turn them into Firelings when you need to reignite the stonesmasher or when you are already next to a Basaltwall.
When you reach the target zone in the north, wait a few seconds: you are teleported out and receive 30 splinters.
Shield level 5 (capacity 1440) gives access to the fight against {creature:The Mega Magmaoid}, in the Dwelling of the Forgotten. Equip **Fire** protection and attack with **Death**.

Enter the room and kill the four {creature:Magmaoid|Magmaoids}. After a few seconds {creature:Blasting Flame|Blasting Flames} start to appear, which heal the other creatures with fire attacks and respawn quickly: keep them away from the Magmaoids. Dead Magmaoids turn into red vortexes that heal anyone who steps over them: kill all four together (for example, in the north) and do not use that part of the room again.

{creature:Massive Magmaoid|Massive Magmaoids} appear. Keep the Blasting Flames away again. Since they heal each other, kill **one at a time**: the first, for example, on the right side; the second in the **centre** of the room, which is where the boss will appear (so it does not go after the shooters).

{creature:The Mega Magmaoid} appears. If you have already used the north, the right and the centre, kill him on the **left** side. {creature:Excess Heat|Excess Heats} appear with him: kill them quickly so they do not heal the boss. When you win, you receive 40 splinters.
When the boss dies it explodes and deals **2,500 Fire Damage** around it. Get away!
Shield level 6 (capacity 1800) lets you enter the last floor of the Dwelling of the Forgotten. Equip **Death** and **Life Drain** protection; the boss is **immune to Death Damage**.
Be careful when jumping to the last floor: creatures come from all sides. Follow the route in the image to the teleport to the levers room.

At the start you just need to attack {creature:The Brainstealer}. Anyone who takes damage from the boss gains a **Madness** counter: the higher it is, the more vulnerable they are to the {creature:Brain Parasite|Brain Parasites}. The counter drops over time if you take no more damage, but it passes on to players who are nearby.
Since the blocker will have more Madness, let the shooters block/kill the Brain Parasites.

At half health the boss becomes immortal and two {creature:Mental-Nexus} appear (one in the north and one in the south). To hurt them, bring one or both {creature:Fleeting Thought|Fleeting Thoughts} next to the Nexus: their attacks do the damage. Nobody should stay near the Nexus, because it heals itself with life steal. Repeat with the second one. Then attack the boss again; at **25%** repeat everything and then kill him.

After the boss, leave the room and go back up through the floors of the Dwelling of the Forgotten to the teleport you came in by into the zone, which takes you back to the hub of {npc:Gnomevisor}. The wiki does not describe how to leave the boss room or how to climb up from the last floor.
Talk to {npc:Gnomevisor}. You receive an {item:Eldritch Casket}, permission to buy more for 75 crystal splinters, the achievement **Some Like It Hot** and you can upgrade the shield to level 7.
Ask {npc:Gnomevisor} for the last upgrade ({key:shield}): capacity 2160. It does not open new zones, but it protects you completely from heat.
This quest is part of the *Those Below* story, linked to the {wiki:Bigfoot's Burden Quest} and the {wiki:Dangerous Depths Quest}.
Splinters and layers are not items: they are quest points you see in the quest log.
